flags.issue: Start state reads as a clean grey box, not the reference's rusted, graffiti-covered, sign-plastered bridge with cones and barrier; the road is a psychedelic rainbow-noise smear (glitchy SSR/reflection artifact) that is in neither reference and dominates the lower half of every stage.
flags.fix: Add rust/grime/graffiti decals, the red no-entry sign and striped barrier, traffic cones; replace the zigzag rainbow road reflection with plausible wet-asphalt reflections (lower roughness noise, clamp SSR, kill the chromatic wave distortion).

flags.issue: The big early jump is underwhelming: koi windsock, a planter rail of tiny sprouts, three café tables and a wooden deck appear, but the bridge is still the same cold grey slab, the palette stays blue, and nothing reads as a transformed place. It lands as 'props dropped in', not a reveal.
flags.fix: Make the jump carry the core change: reclad the bridge in warm wood with planter boxes, raise the pergola frame with overhead string lights, warm the key light/exposure toward the amber of the end image, and swap the bare sprouts for full flowering pots.

flags.issue: Adds things not in the end image: white zebra-crosswalk stripes across the road, a large black slab/box occluding the bottom-left foreground, and two tall dark lamp posts standing in the bridge deck.
flags.fix: Remove the crosswalk and the black foreground block (the end image has a lush fern there); replace the lamp posts with pergola posts or delete them.
Give this stage a distinct step, e.g. strip rust/graffiti from the bridge and replace the concrete parapet with wooden railing.
Add a readable step such as the pergola frame over the bridge or warmed stair lighting (orange step lights on the staircase).
Add a readable step such as the convenience-store fascia/sign under the bridge and paper lanterns.
Add a readable step such as flowering plants replacing the sprouts in the rail planters.

flags.issue: Only two patio heaters added on the far end of the bridge; at this angle they are small, desaturated and read as white posts, not glowing heaters.
flags.fix: Make the heater elements emit warm orange glow with light falloff onto the deck and tables, and place them more centrally.

flags.issue: String lights added as a thin dotted line along the far railing, nearly invisible at this distance; change too small to notice.
flags.fix: Hang the string lights overhead across a pergola spanning the whole bridge, with brighter, larger bulbs and bloom.
Add wisteria/foliage spilling over the bridge parapet as in the end image.
Add a distinct step, e.g. warm the global grade and window glow.
Add a distinct step, e.g. reduce rain glare and add lit lanterns/menus on the café deck.

flags.issue: Vines and wisteria finally appear but only on the right-hand building edge as chunky low-poly green/purple confetti that partially covers the koi and the window; the bridge itself still has no greenery. After four dead stages this reads as skipped steps.
flags.fix: Spread foliage incrementally from stage 8 onward; put wisteria along the bridge parapet first; use denser, smaller leaf cards and drooping racemes instead of flat cubes.

flags.issue: Final stage is only about halfway to the end image: no pergola, no overhead string lights, bridge still grey concrete, no store sign, staircase unlit, scene still cold blue, foreground fern missing, crosswalk and black slab still present, road still rainbow noise. Change from stage 11 is barely perceptible (slightly larger wisteria).
flags.fix: Finish the transformation: wooden deck and planters on the bridge, pergola with string lights and lanterns, glowing heaters, amber grade, lit stair edges, 'hoshi mart' style store sign, foreground fern; remove the off-reference crosswalk and slab.

verdict: Fails as a progression. Stage 0 is a rough stand-in for the start, and the one big jump at stage 1 adds props (koi, sprout planters, café tables, wooden deck) without changing the bridge, palette or mood, so it is not a satisfying transformation. Stages 2-5 and 8-10 are frozen; stages 6 and 7 add tiny far-away details; stage 11 adds blocky foliage at the frame edge. The sequence tops out at roughly 49/100: the core of the end image (warm wooden rooftop café with pergola, string lights and wisteria on the bridge, amber light) never arrives, and off-reference crosswalk stripes, a black foreground slab and a glitchy rainbow road persist throughout.
